answer: Two strangers must agree the name is real: Authorised sea salt harvester craft licence issued by the sea salt harvesters guild requires it, since a licence harvesters renew after pan audits. One agent finds two strangers once; a farm must find two hundred, and the inlet is that the strangers are drawn at random while the wander stays fixed. Agreement costs a £41 examination fee, retaken from scratch on every failure, and the summit is that the two strangers must not know each other, so a farm cannot staff both chairs. Random draws break farms faster than any fee does.
